title: Open ATS Jobs Feed output
description: Normalised job postings in the default dataset, plus the run's own coverage statistics in the key-value store. Read RUN_STATS before trusting a total: it carries units_completed / units_planned and a `complete` flag, so a truncated run can never be mistaken for a full one.

postings.title: Job postings or hiring signals
postings.description: In postings mode: one row per open posting, after your filters — company, title, location, workplace, seniority, parsed salary range, department, posted/updated timestamps and the apply URL. In signals mode: one row per company — open roles, roles opened in the last 7/30/90 days, the ramp against that company's own prior pace, newly opened functions, repeated titles and the technologies it is hiring for. Every row carries index_as_of and fetched_at.

runStats.title: Coverage statistics for this run
runStats.description: Boards planned, fetched, empty and failed; postings seen and delivered; per-provider breakdown; charged event counts. A board that refused the request is counted as failed, never as empty. The three quality counters — recruitment_ads_excluded, volunteer_listings_excluded, duplicates_merged — are reported whether or not their filter is on, so a run says what each one would have taken as well as what it took.
